mods.name: Elytra Compat: Armored + Trims + Enderite
mods.description: Compatibility bridge making Armored Elytra, Elytra Trims and the Enderite Mod work with each other: armor enderite elytras, real trim rendering on combined elytras, decoration preservation on split, no more item loss in the enderite elytra recipe.

releases.notes:
Dependency-resolution correction for Minecraft 26.2.

Changes:
- Elytra Compat itself now requires Fabric Loader >=0.19.3, the actual effective minimum for its direct code path.
- Elytra Trims is now recommended rather than a hard dependency. The compat jar can boot without it; trim-specific integration activates when Elytra Trims is installed.
- Elytra Trims >=4.8.2 remains the supported feature floor when present.
- Armored Elytra >=1.14.1 and Enderite Mod >=1.9.0 remain required because Elytra Compat directly mixes into their classes.
- Build/release metadata is verified before publishing.

Note: Fabric Language Kotlin is a dependency of Elytra Trims, not Elytra Compat. If your installed Fabric Language Kotlin version requires Loader 0.19.5+, that separate dependency still needs either a compatible FLK version or a Loader update.

Compatibility/dependency-floor release for Minecraft 26.2.

Changes:
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer.
- Uses minimum compatible dependency ranges instead of exact runtime pins.
- Armored Elytra >=1.14.1.
- Elytra Trims >=4.8.2.
- Enderite Mod >=1.9.0.
- Supports the Armored Elytra 1.14.x and 1.15+ RenderHelper code shapes.
